title: Count in a longer prefix
statement: Let $l$ be a finite list, let $x$ be an element of its type, and let $i$ be a natural number with $i<\operatorname{length}(l)$. The number of occurrences of $x$ among the first $i+1$ entries equals its number among the first $i$ entries, plus $1$ if the entry at position $i$ is $x$, and plus $0$ otherwise.
hypotheses_covered: An element $x$ of the list's type
